TrainerHouseB1FIntroText:
Hi. Welcome to our
TRAINING HALL.

You may battle a
trainer once per day.
TrainerHouseB1FGoRightInText:
Please go right
through.

You may begin
right away.
TrainerHouseB1FPleaseComeAgainText:
Sorry. Only those
trainers who will

be battling are
allowed to go in.
TrainerHouseB1FSecondChallengeDeniedText:
I'm sorry.
This would be your

second time today.
You're permitted

to enter just once
a day.
TrainerHouseB1FCalBeforeText:
I traveled out
here just so I could battle you.
